firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose a dealer. The dealer takes the first turn, and play proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: The dealer sets up the shared rows, deals each player eight cards, and deals each player one face-up card to start their collection.
At the end of a turn, a player with no cards left in hand ends the round. If the game continues, that player becomes the new dealer and takes the first turn of the next round.
